benefits.en: Daniel will forget his key again, as sure as eggs is eggs.
benefits.zh: 這個表達可以把「我完全沒有任何懷疑」濃縮成一個固定而有力的說法。

benefits.titleZh: 增加帶點幽默的強調效果
benefits.en: The expression is useful when somebody behaves in the same predictable way again and again.
benefits.zh: 當某人一次又一次作出相同而容易預料的行為時，這個表達尤其適合。 奧利弗肯定會告訴所有人。

examples.en: Oliver will tell everyone, as sure as eggs is eggs.
examples.zh: 奧利弗肯定會告訴所有人。
examples.highlight: as sure as eggs is eggs

benefits.titleEn: It Helps Learners Understand Older British Speech
benefits.titleZh: 幫助學生理解較老式的英式說話
benefits.en: Students may encounter the expression in older books, films, television programmes or deliberately old-fashioned dialogue.
benefits.zh: 學生可能會在舊書、電影、電視節目或刻意模仿舊式語氣的對話中遇到這個表達。

benefits.titleEn: It Can Strengthen Predictions and Warnings
benefits.en: If you leave the biscuits there, the dog will find them, as sure as eggs is eggs.
benefits.zh: 如果你把餅乾留在那裏，狗肯定會找到。

benefits.titleZh: 可以靈活放在不同句子位置
benefits.en: at the beginning; at the end; parenthetically in the middle; after a condition or contrast; inside direct speech.
benefits.zh: 這種位置變化能讓學生練習不同的標點、語序及句子組織方式。

benefits.titleEn: It Is Not Automatically Better Than “Definitely”
benefits.titleZh: 並不一定比 Definitely 更好
benefits.en: The idiom is marked and old-fashioned. Definitely, certainly or there is no doubt may be clearer in ordinary modern communication.
benefits.zh: 這個表達帶有明顯的老式語氣。 在一般現代溝通中，definitely、certainly 或 there is no doubt 有時會更清楚自然。

origin.statusEn: Well-Documented Early Forms; Exact Origin Unknown
origin.statusZh: 早期形式有充分記錄；確切來源不明

history.en: Today, the expression is used to emphasise that something is definitely true or certain to happen. It remains recognisable in British English but has a clearly old-fashioned tone.
history.zh: 今天，這個表達用來強調某件事肯定屬實，或某件事必定會發生。 英式英語使用者一般仍能理解它，但其語氣明顯較為老式。

origin.memoryEn: If eggs are obviously eggs, the prediction is obviously certain.
origin.memoryZh: 既然「雞蛋就是雞蛋」是明顯不過的事，說話者的預測也同樣毫無疑問。

rules.en: In ordinary grammar, eggs normally takes are. However, is belongs to the traditional fixed wording taught in this set. Oxford and Cambridge both list the idiom with is.
rules.zh: 在一般文法中，eggs 通常配合 are。 不過，本課教授的傳統固定說法使用 is，因此不能按一般主謂一致規則自行修改。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Change Any Fixed Word
rules.titleZh: 規則二：不要改動任何固定字詞
rules.en: Do Not Change Any Fixed Word
rules.zh: 不要改動任何固定字詞

rules.titleEn: The Expression Shows Very Strong Certainty
rules.titleZh: 規則三：這個表達表示非常強烈的肯定
rules.en: I am completely certain that the bus will be late. The bus might be late. The idiom would make the statement much more certain than the source.
rules.zh: 我完全肯定巴士會遲到。 巴士毫無疑問會遲到。 巴士可能會遲到。 使用這個慣用語會把原本只是「可能」的意思錯誤地加強成「肯定」。

examples.en: The bus will be late, as sure as eggs is eggs.
examples.highlight: as sure as eggs is eggs

rules.en: The idiom must replace the longer certainty wording rather than stand beside it.
rules.zh: 不要保留 Definitely 或 Certainly 毫無疑問，巴士會遲到。 慣用語應取代原本表示肯定的較長說法，而不是與 definitely 或 certainly 一同重複相同意思。

examples.en: As sure as eggs is eggs, the bus will be late.
examples.highlight: As sure as eggs is eggs

rules.titleEn: Do Not Use It for an Honest Possibility
rules.titleZh: 規則五：不能用來表達真正的不確定性
rules.en: The source expresses possibility, but the answer expresses certainty.
rules.zh: 原句表示「可能」，但答案卻變成「肯定」，因此意思並不相同。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Interpret the Eggs Literally
rules.titleZh: 規則六：不要按雞蛋的字面意思理解
rules.en: The expression is about certainty. It is not describing eggs, cooking or farming.
rules.zh: 這個表達與「肯定」有關，並不是在形容雞蛋、烹飪或農業。

rules.titleEn: Avoid It in Formal Neutral Writing
rules.titleZh: 規則八：避免用於正式而中性的文章
rules.en: The results are expected to improve next year.
rules.zh: 在正式報告中，較中性的預測通常會比這個老式慣用語更合適。

rules.titleEn: Use It Only When the Speaker Is Genuinely
rules.titleZh: 規則九：只有在說話者非常肯定時才使用
rules.en: Certain The second sentence gives no reason for such strong certainty.
rules.zh: 只有在說話者非常肯定時才使用 Natural: 第二句沒有提供任何理由支持如此肯定的語氣。
